name: Bulghourji Armenian bar restaurant (NE corner of the St James St junction)

notes.placement: Bulghourji's building is unverified in the notes (R17): the OSM node (108.5,-175.9) lies in w1545817482, whose faces (4.0/4.9 m) cannot hold the >= 6 m facade of 19. This override puts it on the west face of w1392907911 (8.8 m, y -171.8..-180.6): the node's y matches this face's centre (-176.2) exactly, the facade carries the 'ARMENIAN ORTHODOX PATRIARCHATE RD.' plaque so it fronts the road, and 19 (door 550 px = 2.8 m, so ~5 m from the facade) fits the junction space west of it. Confidence low-med.
notes.wall: 19/08: irregular weathered grey blocks: the coursed 'rubble' texture with a neutral grey tint.
notes.facade: 19 (frontal, 2016) / 08 (2023): round-arched studded double door ~1.25 x 2.8 m (dark brown-black in 2023), flanking round-arched windows with scroll grilles and solid shutters, white tile street plaque (5 x 3 tiles, ~0.85 x 0.5 m) left of the door at the door crown, marble inscription panel and an oval oculus with a scroll grille above the door, LED floodlight (wall_lantern stand-in). u from the north end.
